working_definition: Grouped author type 'Tm1/Tm2/Tm4/Tm6 neuron' (L3_12) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 optic lobe atlas: medulla-class transmedullary neurons Tm1, Tm2, Tm4 and Tm6 not resolved from one another.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a transmedullary neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Grouped call: immature Tm1 (FBbt:00052325), Tm2 (FBbt:00052326) and Tm4 (FBbt:00052330) are all children of immature transmedullary neuron; no immature Tm6 term exists, and Tm6 is a transmedullary neuron, so this is the most specific common parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm1 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm2 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm4 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053274 'immature transmedullary neuron' (broad match); members Tm1, Tm2, Tm4 (immature terms listed) and Tm6 (no immature term).
